source.title: City of Austin Impervious Cover 2023 plus narrow OSM sidewalk gap fills
derivation: Clip connected City road polygons to 24th x120..360 and San Jacinto to z270.
Use adjoining City sidewalks and broad DKR Pavement footprint, with bounded lateral apron extent.
Fill missing classification only in 1.3m-radius known OSM sidewalk buffers; subtract City asphalt and structures.
Crosswalks retain asphalt; short missing-classification ends are filled only inside their 1.3m-radius mapped trace.
Guard x284..315 bridge region against expansion beyond combined City road-and-sidewalk footprint.
Simplify non-bridge polygon boundaries by at most 0.02m; preserve bridge original boundaries.
Split into longitudinal 4m strips; constrained triangulate irregular pieces and pair into convex quads.
limits: Height-free XZ geometry only. City elevation attributes are null; runtime must use separately verified deck/street heights.
Early-2023 aerial land cover does not establish current access. North bridge OSM access=no is retained as physical context.
OSM-only fillers are inferred surface continuity, not surveyed edges; their provenance and area are explicit.
Route stops at z270 before the unresolved stadium steps. Off-route parking and creek are not reconstructed.

preservation.appliesTo: clearanceSurfaces only; original 827 rendered and collider floor cells are unchanged
preservation.reason: Same-camera source/repaired comparison at player(316.6917,267.9940) showed a rectangular opening cut into the source stadium facade.
limits: No source-wall absence is inferred from the unobserved or occluded northern Z100..170 region.
These are XZ preservation checks against live source intersections; a fresh browser view must verify the repaired facade.
Preserved source geometry may overlap authored floor near the wall. Only source removal changes; no wall or public interior is invented.
